import json,hashlib,pathlib
sha=lambda p: hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
d=json.load(open("eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json"))
a=d["artifact_snapshot"]; print([k for k in a])
arts=a["artifacts"]; mis=[p for p,h in arts.items() if sha(p)!=h]
cur={p.as_posix() for p in pathlib.Path("system-spec").rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
print(len(arts),"mismatch",mis,"missing_from_snapshot",sorted(cur-set(arts)),"extra",sorted(set(arts)-cur))
print("spec-state in snap", arts.get("system-spec/spec-state.json"), "index", arts.get("system-spec/index.md"))
print({k:v for k,v in a.items() if k!="artifacts"})
print(json.dumps(d["gate_results"],ensure_ascii=False)[:1500])
print(json.dumps(d["audit_delegations"],ensure_ascii=False)[:1500])
'
